summary: [¶] - i. The Petitioner has filed the instant Petition for truing up of the Annual Fixed Charges for the 2019-24 tariff period and the determination of AFC for 202429 tariff period. MPPMCL has added that the truing up and sharing of transmission charges for the 2019–24 tariff period should be carried out strictly in accordance with the applicable CERC Sharing Regulations.
